messages.content: RoboRide Inc announces expansion to 50 new cities. Millfield is listed for Phase 2 deployment, expected in 2 months.

Business closing: Carlos Ruiz — full day at the shop — complete brake overhaul on a 2019 f-150, diagnose a rough idle on a honda accord, and close out two routine services. keep the schedule tight and the quality high.

You Host the monthly Auto Row worker appreciation lunch — discounted daily special for all shop employees. Put a handwritten chalkboard sign out front. Spend time at the counter talking with regulars, learning names of the newer hires.. Savings grew by $116.
